statement: A published community summary describes 'up to 3 touch points USB / 4 Bluetooth', whereas Linux's struct explicitly reserves three USB or four Bluetooth nine-byte *touch reports*, each of which contains two four-byte contact points; the terminology/count units disagree.

applicability.revision: research revisions: Linux 4056b3c, historical Linux v6.1 830b3c6, SDL 535d80b, OpenPuck 29f4d1e, community 290e4a2; retail revision unknown
applicability.scope: Community playstation.md 38–42 versus hid-playstation.c 454–505. Treat the kernel layout as a host parser contract; do not silently convert report slots into simultaneous fingers or claim actual packet count from physical hardware.
